mapper.update: UPDATE article SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.author_id, a.author_name, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.is_deleted, a.status, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.sort FROM article a LEFT JOIN blog_attachments ba ON a.id = ba.article_id AND ba.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
